operations.title: Create blank sheet document
operations.realtime: library events appended in-transaction, published after commit

risks.description: Creation is transactional with authoritative re-read and durable realtime events.

operations.title: Whole-document setup sheet save (autosave)
operations.authorization: gm, or player whose selected profile links the sheet (or player-visible sheet)

risks.description: The client submits the entire document; creation-relevant fields (levelUp totals, remainingEdges, currentTeam) are accepted as sent. Legality is advisory display math, not authority.

Server-owned lanes (equipmentState, serverPrivate, usage ledgers) are preserved server-side while the rest of the document is client-owned, so a sheet is simultaneously authoritative and freely editable.
Sheet identity is the slug. Rename allocates a new slug and retargets map token references atomically, but nothing else follows.
Trainer currentTeam/boxedPokemon slug arrays and player-profile linkedCharacters are NOT retargeted on rename; renaming a pokemon silently severs team membership and player control.
Deletion removes map references but leaves profile linkedCharacters and trainer team arrays pointing at the dead slug until the next full-profile save validates them.

operations.title: Create/move/delete sheet folders
operations.revisionControl: folder rows + document folder fields in one transaction

risks.description: Folders are logical SQLite rows; onboarding destinations can reuse them, but folder placement also flags player accessibility (isRuntimePlayerFolderPath), which is an implicit visibility rule.
Profiles live as JSON files under the campaign root while every sheet they link lives in SQLite; there is no shared transaction between profile links and sheet state.

operations.title: Update profile display name and linked characters

risks.description: Profile updates have no revision or compare-and-set; two concurrent GM tabs silently overwrite each other's link lists.
Link existence is validated only at write time; later sheet rename/delete invalidates stored links with no repair or attention trail at the profile.
currentTeam/boxedPokemon are plain slug arrays inside the trainer document; the server never validates that referenced pokemon exist, are unique across trainers, or are profile-consistent.
A team can reference deleted, renamed, or another player's pokemon; live-play send-out discovers the failure later.

operations.title: Equipment lifecycle operations
operations.revisionControl: operation IDs + sheet revision read sets, exact retry

risks.description: Plan 8 equipment authority already provides serialized identities, op journals, and exact retry; onboarding must route equipment grants through it rather than writing legacy slot strings.
Authoritative item actions coexist with raw inventory row editing through whole-sheet save; onboarding-created rows must carry canonical identity so later actions resolve.

operations.title: Encounter cast, reserves, and participant addition
operations.revisionControl: encounter document revisions + command op IDs

risks.description: Participant addition is revision-checked, but candidates are raw sheets; readiness/ownership grouping is absent (owned by P9-074/P9-075).
